info.description: HTTP API for finding facilities located within 1 km of a search location. The API guide identifies its current URL version as v1.0.0; this is not a documented OpenAPI metadata version. The guide cautions against sending large numbers of requests within a short period. Authentication is unspecified.
info.title: Search Nearby API

get.description: Returns data in JSON format for facilities located within 1 km of the search location. Use HK80 coordinates for the search location. The API guide says its current URL version is v1.0.0 and warns that old versions may be removed without notice.

parameters.description: Coordinate value of HK80 Easting, in metres. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: Coordinate value of HK80 Northing, in metres. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: y

parameters.description: Language of the output JSON. The guide documents English and Traditional Chinese. The guide does not explicitly label query requiredness.
parameters.name: lang

200.description: OK. The guide states that data is returned in JSON format but does not document the response object's fields or structure.

400.description: Bad Request, for example, invalid query parameters.
